title: Federal prosecutors say a Saudi national was arrested over bugging an OpenAI executive conference room; OpenAI found the audio recorder around September 30 (The San Francisco Standard)
summary: The San Francisco Standard: Federal prosecutors say a Saudi national was arrested over bugging an OpenAI executive conference room; OpenAI found the audio recorder around September 30 — An OpenAI engineer has been arrested on suspicion of hiding an audio recording device in an executive conference room …
